The web of world-wide Air Mail routes is keyed by Pan American's
far-flung routes of the lying Clipper ships, and supplemented by con-
necting rail and steames services everywhere. Air Mail is as much as
thirty times faster than ordinary mail. Received first-read first-and
answered first, Air Mail commands special attention, is advantagcously
used both for routine and for rush correspondence, documents, collec-
tions, and many other items of a business or social nature. Modern
lightweight stationery saves postage.
Before starting your trip, leave a copy of your itinerary with your
correspondents, cautioning them to post their Air Mail letters in suffi
cient time and correctly addressed to reach you without fail at each
point en route. (Your local postmaster can give you full details.) Other-
wise, Air Mail addressed to you en route which arrives after your de
parture will either trail you by surface or be returned to the sender.
